description: This file defines tracing categories, utility functions, and classes related to logging and diagnostics within the WPEFramework project. It includes category definitions, message formatting, and classes for representing method entry/exit and duration logs.

classes.name: Constructor
classes.description: Represents a generic message category with static text, used for tracing.

classes.name: CopyConstructor
classes.description: Represents a copy constructor message category with static text.

classes.name: AssignmentOperator
classes.description: Represents an assignment operator message category with static text.

classes.name: Destructor
classes.description: Represents a destructor message category with static text.

classes.name: MethodEntry
classes.description: Logs entry into a method, inherits from BaseCategoryType with TRACING metadata.

classes.name: MethodExit
classes.description: Logs exit from a method, inherits from BaseCategoryType with TRACING metadata.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Logs the duration of an operation, inherits from BaseCategoryType with TRACING metadata.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Utility function for formatting strings, for backwards compatibility.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Overloaded utility function returning a formatted string.

methods.name: MethodEntry
methods.description: Constructor that logs method entry with method name.

methods.name: MethodExit
methods.description: Constructor that logs method exit with method name.

methods.name: Duration
methods.description: Constructor that logs the duration between a start time and now, with optional formatting.
